name: Zime
description: Zime connects Claude to your customer calls, CRM, deals, and internal knowledge. Ask natural-language questions across your book of business: what objections came up in a deal, why deals are won or lost, how reps are positioning against competitors, what to cover before a call. Zime synthesizes call intelligence with CRM and pipeline context to return accurate, evidence-backed answers with links to the source calls.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zime to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zime to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.zime.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zime MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zime provides these MCP tools: ask_zime.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zime?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Zime in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Zime requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zime is developed by Zime. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
